message: You know that feeling when you’ve been telling everyone about fire safety, and then you stumble upon a resource that just backs you up? Well, I found this great guide from the NFPA that lays out all the home fire safety tips I've been chatting about. 📚 It’s a nice reminder that being prepared doesn't have to be overwhelming—just a few simple steps can make a big difference.
